# Wire v1 tables (generated)

Parameters come from the JSON Schemas in [`../v1/schemas/`](../v1/schemas/) (generated from the Rust serde types); *result members* and *golden errors* come from the runtime golden [`../v1/conformance/golden.json`](../v1/conformance/golden.json) (342 cases, host 1.0.3, headless; native GUI behavior is qualified separately). The golden records the JSON kind of each top-level member of the results it observed; members that only appear in other situations (or on a native desktop) are not listed. The schemas and the golden are the source of truth; the [protocol reference](../README.md) explains semantics.

Regenerate with `python3 scripts/docs/generate-wire-tables.py` (`--check` verifies).
